description: Retrieve the DRAFT Agent Charter document suite for an Agent Company. Returns each instrument as Markdown plus a link to a single branded PDF pack. NEVIS suite: Articles of Organization, Operating Agreement, Agent Mandate & Authority Charter, Power of Attorney, Wallet Authority Schedule, Register of Members, Written Resolutions, Beneficial Ownership Declaration, Consent to Act, Risk/AML Policy, Indemnification Agreement, and a machine-readable mandate (JSON). WYOMING STANDALONE suite (the $299 tier): Formation Summary, Wyoming Operating Agreement (W.S. 17-29, with agent-delegation clauses), Agent Mandate & Authority Charter, Authority Resolution & Power of Attorney, Wallet Authority Schedule, Organizational Resolutions, US Tax & Compliance Memorandum (EIN, Form 5472/1065, WY annual report), and the machine-readable mandate. Available ONLY after payment is confirmed. Every document is a DRAFT for review by the OffshoreProz team and a licensed attorney.
